applies_why: The judge text decides whether C4/Jeremiah 22:30 counts against a link by noting the target limb was dropped and no live link remains.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge text does not count C4/Jeremiah 22:30 as an unanswered witness or toward a broken link; it treats the target as dropped and the result underdetermined, which is not counting and so obeys K-G4.
